style: cinematic 3D, Pixar-quality, dusty vest, hard hat, matte, deadpan slapstick
shot: vertical 9:16, camera always moving, size shifts wide to macro; pushes in on 2.1, 4.15, 7.6, wide on 9.0
character: PIGLET FOREMAN: businesslike pig, dignity to the last; back curves only in final beat
cast: BULL: large, necktie, stamp in hand, close to lens, never speaks. TWO BG PIGLETS: small, past puddle, building lean-to, never near lens
props: form: tick-in-circle stamp from hook, 2nd stamp at beat 7. brick: tagged, from wheelbarrow, rotated, set by ready row, thrown back in. trowel: from belt at drop-thud. wheelbarrow: in at beat 5, off at beat 9, crashes puddle at 7.6. puddle, stick lean-to: from 0.0, sheds a branch when hit; ready row, gravel, bucket from 0.0.
setting: bright sunny morning, open construction site; brick row by poured foundation; gravel pile, bucket, puddle; two piglets building branch lean-to nearby

audio.language: Russian, verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: male, low chest voice ~130Hz, dry, businesslike deadpan, ~5 syll/sec, native Russian, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.lip_sync: snout/jaw opens each syllable, his own voice, never a voice over

timeline.a: Hook: a stamp swings past the lens from off-frame, owner unseen, blacks out the frame; he staggers behind it, hard hat clacking
dry, deadpan; walks at the lens, chest fills the frame, form shaking in his trotters
no gap; stretch peaks, spine snaps straight, form flies up across the frame
Drops onto all four trotters, thud kicks dust, form slaps flat; grabs the trowel, smears mortar; wide catches the two piglets past the puddle hoisting a branch onto their lean-to
Wheelbarrow crashes in, bull brakes hard, shoves his shoulder, muzzle huge at lens; flips the board, piglet grabs the tagged brick
flat disbelief; brick swings a full turn edge to edge across the frame, held at the lens
Brick fills the frame, drops away revealing the bull slamming his stamp on the form
Sets the brick beside the ready row, flush; bull grabs it, hurls it into the wheelbarrow
Bull kicks the wheelbarrow rolling toward the puddle, staying close to the lens; wheel clips gravel, grit sprays the piglet; he snaps the trowel up

flat and dry, eyes locked on lens, trowel lowering; wheelbarrow slams into the puddle as the beat opens, mud erupting in continuous spray past him, never on his snout, mouth stays visible, ripples racing out, gravel kicked loose, branch snapping off the lean-to
timeline.camera: whip-pans to chase the splash, tight, never settling

timeline.a: Trowel settles in silence; sits on the bucket, back curving first time, tracing its rim; piglets behind lean the branch back

must_appear: wordless tick-in-circle stamp; stamp crossing the lens at 0.0; brick filling the frame at 5.15; bull huge at lens from 3.2; wheelbarrow splashing the puddle as the last line starts, spray churning to the end
negative_prompt: night, dusk, lamp, dim, moody, dark scene; locked-off camera; bricks stacking, floating objects; duplicated brick, form, trowel, stamp; stamp leaving his hand; second bull, crowd, hands; background piglets speaking, near lens, or crossing the puddle; third piglet; tiered stick construction; cuts; slow speech, English, foreign accent; subtitles, watermark, text overlay, Cyrillic, readable stamp text
motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses or fills frame: piglet, form, brick, bull, wheelbarrow, mud or camera; never only the mouth moving
